findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe string operations in markup handling
 * @description String operations that might bypass security controls
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-markup-string-ops
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python

from BinaryExpr binop
where
  binop.getOp() instanceof Add or
  binop.getOp() instanceof Mod
select binop, "String operation that might bypass markup escaping: " + binop.getOp().toString()
findings.hypothesis: Look for string concatenation or formatting operations that might bypass escaping mechanisms

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name HTML entity references in escape function
 * @description Check for proper handling of HTML entity references and special characters
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/markup-entity-handling
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-079
 */

import python

from Call call
where
  call.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() = "replace" and
  exists(StringLiteral lit | 
    lit = call.getAnArg() and
    lit.getText() in ["&", "<", ">", "\"", "'"]
  )
select call, "String replacement for HTML entity: " + call.getAnArg().(StringLiteral).getText()
findings.hypothesis: HTML entity replacements must be in correct order to avoid double-encoding or encoding bypasses
